why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. Every readable result is a retailer or brand-store listing for a single product (BESTEK, Tessan, VEVOR, LENCENT, a generic Newegg seller), five results have no text, and the listings contradict each other and themselves on wattage. Nobody compares the options, tests them, or explains which US devices actually need conversion. A focused page comparing the handful of 220V-to-110V adapter combos on rated watts, plug coverage, certification and price, with a direct pick, would be the only real answer in the set.
